title: Verify a webhook signature
hints: hmac.new(secret_bytes, message_bytes, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(); the message is f"{timestamp}.".encode() + body_bytes. Convert str to bytes with .encode("utf-8").
Find the header by comparing key.lower() == "x-signature"; then split the value on "," and each piece on "=" with partition, stripping whitespace.
Collect all v1 values into a list and int() the t value inside try/except ValueError; any failure returns False.
Check abs(now - t) <= tolerance, recompute sign_payload with the header's t, and return any(hmac.compare_digest(expected, s) for s in sigs).
